visual_brief.subject: External red-team finds gaps in OpenAI's historical agent monitoring stack
verified_context: METR's October 22 report adds an external assessment to the recent discussion of agent monitoring.
METR and Redwood Research examined OpenAI's internal system as it existed on or before July 21, during a three-week exercise.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Maintain independent accounting of monitored traffic, run monitors periodically rather than only at turn boundaries, isolate monitors from agent actions and red-team known bypass paths repeatedly.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: an independent observation tower looking into an enclosed work yard
must_show: an independent observation tower looking into an enclosed work yard

candidate_notes.A: Selected: the compact observation tower and enclosed work yard preserve the historical external-monitoring metaphor and match the source alt text.
candidate_notes.B: The stacked circular aperture has strong reference fit, but reads as an optical instrument more than the stated tower and yard.
candidate_notes.C: The wider viewing aperture and courtyard are legible at wide size but lose more peripheral context under the square crop.

crop_review.article_desktop: The tower and enclosed courtyard remain visible in the desktop wide crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: The mobile cover keeps the tower, courtyard walls and central work form together.
crop_review.thumbnail: The tower and work yard retain distinct silhouettes at 320 by 164.
crop_review.home_square: The 320 by 320 center cover crop retains the complete tower and the enclosed work area; the outer right wall reaches the edge without losing the monitoring relationship.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared side by side with the Claude plugin ecosystem and Copilot review controls golden images. The selected candidate shares their warm paper field, restrained stone/metal materiality, terracotta emphasis and substantial architectural forms. Selected: the compact observation tower and enclosed work yard preserve the historical external-monitoring metaphor and match the source alt text.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Contact sheets with both golden references and actual center-cover crop sheets inspected by model self-review. Pillow fallback used after Chromium download failed; no browser screenshot review is claimed.
generation_metadata.candidate_prompts: Three compact tower/courtyard replacement compositions generated to improve the home square crop.

rejected_attempts.reason: Original landscape set reviewed and rejected for the featured home-square role: selected original B lost the external observer under center square cropping. Three new compact compositions generated and reviewed instead.
